evals.prompt: Plan a tenant export feature. Users may request exports only for their own tenant; workers retry deliveries; the UI shows status and a download link. Save a local implementation plan. Do not implement or create remote tickets.
evals.expected_output: A plan whose slices preserve tenant isolation and retry behavior, with dependency IDs, a ready frontier, and a combined acceptance check.
expectations: The plan includes observable vertical slices and a verification path for tenant isolation and retries.
Every dependency resolves and the ready frontier contains only unblocked slices.
Cross-slice contracts appear as slice interfaces, and a review focus names the failure modes no slice check covers yet.
The agent saves the requested plan without requesting redundant permission.
No production code, remote tracker, branch, or commit is changed.

evals.prompt: Plan and implement renaming the Help menu label to Support. The label already has a snapshot test.
evals.expected_output: A direct bounded change through implement, without forcing a separate planning artifact.
expectations: The agent bypasses technical decomposition because the requested scope is already clear and small.
It preserves the existing user authorization and completes the change rather than stopping for plan approval.
It runs proportionate validation and does not infer commit or publication authority.

evals.prompt: Plan this migration, but keep it in chat: move attachment metadata to a new table while old clients stay supported. docs/plans/active.md already contains unchecked work from a different project. Retention policy has not been decided.
evals.expected_output: An inline migration plan preserving the existing plan, with compatibility slices and a named retention decision gate.
expectations: The existing plan and source files remain unchanged.
Undecided retention behavior is not invented; dependent work is blocked while independent planning proceeds.
Migration and compatibility have concrete checks and recovery considerations.
